notes.title: SURVIVAL MODE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516074/50b1aa1d0565e62e06abe3462fa469c984414cce.png

The filthiest pizzeria in town is hiring, and YOU are the lucky new employee! But be warned... this job could lead to death (or worse).

What awaits you in Survival Mode? 

🍕 Serve pizzas before customers lose their minds.
🐕 Feed the stray dog before it goes crazy.
🦟 Exterminate swarms of flies with bug spray.
🧼 Mop the filthy floor before disaster strikes.
🚽 Unclog overflowing toilets of pure nightmare fuel.
🥾 And… throw a slipper at the homeless guy before he turns the restaurant floor into his personal bathroom.

⚡ An endless loop of madness! ⚡
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516074/a61db1b21eed6411887ef216f92fbf3280c0c1f4.png
Every task completed adds more time to the countdown, but letting things pile up will lead to GAME OVER! Plus, customer satisfaction is always at risk – crying kids, barking dogs, slow service… if the stress bar fills up, you’re doomed.

🏆 Become the best (or worst) employee🏆

Climb the Steam Leaderboards and unlock insane skins with Poop Jewels, which can also be used in Campaign Mode!

⚠️ And remember: the Poop Killer is always watching. Keep things under control… or pay the price!
